rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing dissatisfaction or resentment, especially about another person or situation.

example.english: I complain all the time that my job is too tiring.
example.traditional: 我成日埋怨份工太辛苦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 maai4 jyun3 fan6 gung1 taai3 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this for moaning about personal pain or illness, including reporting a symptom in a complaining tone rather than making a formal complaint.

example.english: I complain all day that my stomach hurts.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 san1 go3 tou5 tung3

rows.note: Use this when making a complaint to an authority, organization, or the police.

example.english: I will complain to the Consumer Council that the shop is overcharging.
example.traditional: 我會向消費者委員會投訴間店舖亂收費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 hoeng3 siu1 fai3 ze2 wai2 jyun4 wui2 tau4 sou3 gaan1 dim3 pou3 lyun6 sau1 fai3
